home.heroTitle: Jordan's digital youth income & training platform
home.heroBody: One week of hands-on training. A marketplace to sell into after. Sell, Create, or Build a real income — no degree, no capital required.
home.summitBody: The Muntaliq National Training Summit brings 100 participants to Amman for a plenary and a two-day, hands-on bootcamp across four tracks — closing with a graduation ceremony and certificates for every attendee.
home.day1Body: 9:00 opening plenary — sponsor and government addresses — then training rotation across Affiliate, E-commerce, Vibe Coding & AI, and Sales Skills through 16:40.
home.day2Body: Training rotation continues from 9:30, closing with certificate handover and sponsor recognition at the 16:00 graduation ceremony.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Why Intaleq exists: the economic and geographic gap it closes, and the self-sustaining model behind Jordan's Digital Youth Income & Training Platform.
aboutPage.heroTitle: A real gap. A real solution.
aboutPage.heroBody: Intaleq — Arabic for "launch" — is Jordan's digital youth income and training platform. It exists because free content and one-off grants haven't closed the gap between Jordan's youth and the global digital economy.
aboutPage.modelTitle: Built to outlast its own funding.
aboutPage.modelBody: Traditional programs rely on a grant and stop once it runs out. Intaleq is modeled on ArabNet: a self-sustaining annual event, with an Amman plenary that funds and anchors a hands-on training week. Once the model is proven, it's built to expand to other governorates.
aboutPage.plenaryBody: The annual Intaleq plenary in Amman — panels, keynotes, and Jordan's digital economy practitioners in one room, one day.
aboutPage.trainingBody: A hands-on training week in Amman, in partnership with Jordan Bromine Company, across seven digital income tracks.

tracksPage.metaDescription: Seven digital income tracks across three worlds — Sell, Create, Build — taught hands-on in Amman.
tracksPage.heroBody: Pick one track. Spend a week building the skill, the product, and the first client or sale that makes it real.

trainersPage.metaDescription: Meet the practitioners leading Intaleq 2026's hands-on training tracks.
trainersPage.heroBody: Every trainer at Intaleq is actively working in the field they teach — not presenting theory, but the exact process they use to earn from it.
trainersPage.ctaTitle: Are you a practitioner in a digital income field?
trainersPage.ctaBody: Intaleq is looking to expand its trainer bench for future cohorts.
